summary: The bad() method guards its IO.writeLine call with IO.staticReturnsFalse(), a static helper that always returns false, so the if-condition is a CWE-570 expression that is always false and the body is dead code. Replaced the constant-false helper with IO.staticReturnsTrueOrFalse(), which returns a genuine runtime boolean, so the branch is now a real conditional that can execute while preserving the feature.
